title: Goal
question: Am I on time?
readings: the big number and "of 600 k€": where it stands against the target
the bar's length: the share of the target reached
the tick on the bar: where the expected pace says it should be today
the words under it: the share reached, the expected share, ahead or behind
strengths: says at once whether the period will end on target
the pace makes a mid-month number readable
avoid: without a period (start and due): use bullet, which reads a value against a target and ranges
when the target moves every day: use metric

unit.description: Written after the value and the target: "k€"

action: mode list: open what is left to win (the open quotes, the late orders)
